High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready copy of the Players Committee virtual card [[K-2SO (Kay-Tuesso)]] (Virtual Set 6, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Virtual Cards/Set 6/Light/K-2S0.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1s9KTltBLOpq1EAkyVQxr5fnua_tJ7_0b/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>K-2S0.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,320 bytes, SHA-256 <code>75405b5a8ba1ce6e1246581ae524cb753e0878f13d0d38d3e183199e6ab6b232</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:V6-L-K-2SO_(Kay-Tuesso)-original-2018-07-08-022435b.gif]].
